resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Indonesian source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Indonesian pass identified 25 actionable literal, register, circuit, thermal, and technical-clarity defects; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Indonesian human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The worked-example heading used an awkward literal phrase meaning a successful example.
evidence: The previous title was Contoh yang berhasil.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the natural technical heading Contoh perhitungan.

findings.summary: The power paragraph translated thermal dissipation capability as thermal capacity and free space.
evidence: The previous text used kapasitas termal dan ruang kepala.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with kemampuan membuang panas and margin keamanan.

findings.summary: The unit-conversion instruction used an English technical noun instead of the established Indonesian term.
evidence: The previous text said Jaga konsistensi unit sebelum menghitung.
findings.resolution: Changed unit to the standard Indonesian term satuan.

findings.summary: The limits paragraph used jaringan where the surrounding electrical terminology consistently refers to circuits.
evidence: The previous sentence referred to jaringan seri dan paralel.
findings.resolution: Changed it to rangkaian seri dan paralel for consistent technical usage.

findings.summary: The heating-power heading used a less precise noun for the heating process.
evidence: The previous title was Daya pemanas.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Daya pemanasan.

findings.summary: The Joule-heating worked-example heading used an awkward literal phrase.
evidence: The previous title was Contoh yang berhasil.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Contoh perhitungan.

findings.summary: The heading used a literal question structure that was less natural as a technical section title.
evidence: The previous title was Apa yang mempengaruhi pemanasan.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Faktor yang memengaruhi pemanasan.

findings.summary: The current-squared relationship was stated with an awkward noun phrase for doubling current.
evidence: The previous bullet used penggandaan arus menghasilkan daya pemanasan empat kali lipat.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as melipatgandakan arus and four times greater heating power.

findings.summary: The safety paragraph translated safety margin as physical clearance and used a less precise power-source term.
evidence: The previous text used ruang kepala and catu daya.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with margin keamanan and sumber daya while preserving the continuous-current warning.

findings.summary: The node definition left the central circuit term in English.
evidence: The previous bullet began Node adalah.
findings.resolution: Changed Node to the standard Indonesian electrical term Simpul.

findings.summary: The branch definition referred to two nodes with an untranslated English term.
evidence: The previous bullet ended dengan dua node.
findings.resolution: Changed it to dua simpul.

findings.summary: The loop definition needed a more natural Indonesian description of a closed path.
evidence: The previous text used jalur tertutup yang kembali ke titik awalnya.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as lintasan tertutup yang kembali ke titik awalnya.

findings.summary: The series-connection definition used an awkward verb phrase for providing a current path.
evidence: The previous text said Sambungan seri hanya memberikan arus satu jalur melalui komponen.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Rangkaian seri menyediakan satu jalur arus melalui komponen.

findings.summary: The current-law example left node untranslated in an otherwise Indonesian explanation.
evidence: The previous sentence used masuk ke sebuah node.
findings.resolution: Changed node to simpul.

findings.summary: The cell heading used an unnecessary secara construction.
evidence: The previous title was Sel secara seri dan paralel.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the concise Sel seri dan paralel.

findings.summary: The parallel-cell statement placed kira-kira awkwardly and made the capacity increase unclear.
evidence: The previous bullet ended kapasitas dan arus yang tersedia bertambah kira-kira.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it to state that voltage remains fixed while available capacity and current approximately increase.

findings.summary: The heading used memecahkan, which is less idiomatic for analyzing an electrical circuit.
evidence: The previous title was Memecahkan rangkaian nyata.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Menganalisis rangkaian nyata.

findings.summary: The analysis checklist used an overly literal imperative for assigning circuit quantities.
evidence: The previous bullet began Tandai tegangan simpul.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the clearer imperative Tentukan tegangan simpul.

findings.summary: The KCL checklist used node in English even though the circuit terminology was being localized.
evidence: The previous bullet said Terapkan KCL pada node independen.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Terapkan KCL pada simpul independen.

findings.summary: The TCR worked-example heading used the same awkward literal phrase as other examples.
evidence: The previous title was Contoh yang berhasil.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Contoh perhitungan.

findings.summary: The right-triangle explanation used awkward literal geometry wording and an unclear SOH-CAH-TOA explanation.
evidence: The previous text said sisi yang berlawanan berhadapan dengannya and sisi yang berdekatan menyentuhnya tidak termasuk sisi miring.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the paragraph with explicit Indonesian definitions of opposite, adjacent, and hypotenuse sides.

findings.summary: The example heading was an incomplete literal phrase.
evidence: The previous title was Temukan sisinya.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Menentukan panjang sisi.

findings.summary: The heat-capacity worked-example heading used an awkward literal phrase.
evidence: The previous title was Contoh yang berhasil.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Contoh perhitungan.

findings.summary: The object-versus-material heading was a literal contrast that sounded unnatural in Indonesian.
evidence: The previous title was Objek versus material.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Benda dan material.

findings.summary: The heat-flux worked-example heading used an awkward literal phrase.
evidence: The previous title was Contoh yang berhasil.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Contoh perhitungan.
